title: Two verses under a tab part — every view carries the words
description: Four quarter notes on a six-string guitar part (staffKind both) with two verse lines: verse one is whole words, verse two splits "Rising" and "water" across note pairs so hyphens are derived on every staff kind. Pins the standalone tab view drawing verse rows below the strings (the shared plan already priced the syllable widths, so the digits' columns do not move), the notation view drawing them as it always has, and the both view carrying them once, between the staves.
